steps.text: Because Yoneda embedding, Yoneda embedding is fully faithful because Yoneda embedding preserves and reflects isomorphisms.
Because f≅g if f*=g* or f_*=g_*, f≅g if f≤g and g≤f.
Because X is L-separated if f≅g implies f=g, full subcategory of Cat(V) consisting of all L-separated V-categories because definition of L-separated.
Because it suffices to consider Z=E, f_*=g_* implies (f⋅x)_*=f_*⋅x_*=g_*⋅x_*=(g⋅x)_*.
Because f_*=g_* implies (f⋅x)_*=f_*⋅x_*=g_*⋅x_*=(g⋅x)_*, X is L-separated if f≅g implies f=g because functoriality of _*.
